content.text: , I have created a basic working version (tests are not working yet)
https://github.com/umd-lib/fcrepo4/commit/1143f6b4121aa9b3dbbad70c61223f5857b18f2b
I want to check with you and get your feedback before proceeding. I'm sure you would have a lot of it since It's been several months I worked with fcrepo.

, I think this is a good start, but too tightly coupled to the kernel.  Ideally, there would be no kernel changes at all for the audit service.  Instead, you should follow the pattern of the JMS module and subscribe to the eventBus events that are already being generated:
https://github.com/fcrepo4/fcrepo4/blob/master/fcrepo-jms/src/main/java/org/fcrepo/jms/observer/JMSTopicPublisher.java
So I think you should create a new fcrepo-audit module and move the AuditServiceImpl.java there.
I would also like to see a System property used to enable the creation of these nodes, called fcrepo.audit.container, whose value is used instead of hard-coding /audit/.
Working version of InternalAuditor created. Tests are pending.
PR:
https://github.com/fcrepo4-labs/fcrepo-audit/pull/1
PR:
https://github.com/fcrepo4-labs/fcrepo-webapp-plus/pull/8
Added tests and updated PR based on feedback.
I've completed functional testing of this, and I found one small issue: the audit records for deleted nodes can't be accessed because of an error checking the references for being skolems (
).  I have a PR to catch this error and allow the audit nodes to be accessed.
Just a couple of minor comments then this is ready to merge.
Resolved with
https://github.com/fcrepo4-labs/fcrepo-audit/commit/3d7d6d348424df73940bf992b2770cdbc92dc3d5
and
https://github.com/fcrepo4-labs/fcrepo-webapp-plus/commit/430914bd95fa761105e39b7d91f7b2662010d2d3
If an audit container is configured, internal audit events should automatically be generated and posted to that container.

PR: https://github.com/fcrepo4-labs/fcrepo-webapp-plus/pull/8
